**Context.** CompTIA lists Security+ SY0-801 for launch on or around 17 November 2026. SY0-701 is the current version. The pages below mention Security+ or other CompTIA exams.

`guides/certifications.md`, `guides/faq.md`, `guides/study-plan-90-days.md`, `roadmap/01-foundations.md`, `resources/courses.md`, `resources/practice-labs.md`, `resources/youtube.md`, `tracks/blue-team.md`, `tracks/grc.md`, `tracks/red-team.md`, `tracks/identity-and-access-management.md` and several career profiles.

**Steps.**
1. After the launch, confirm the new exam code and retirement date for SY0-701 on CompTIA's site.
2. Update `guides/certifications.md`.
3. Check that the free video course used as a syllabus in phase 1 and in the 90-day plan matches the current exam.
4. While there, recheck Network+, CySA+, PenTest+, SC-300 and the OSCP name.

**Done when.** The exam details are current and the pages carry new review dates.
